clue.text: Huge Greek character blowing top

indicators.note: losing its top means the word's first letter is lost

parts.note: omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A huge Greek man loses his temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blowing top' looks like an angry outburst; here it removes the first letter, O, from OMEGA.
explanation.definitionFit: A direct synonym: both words describe something enormous or very great.

clue.text: Old boy's story about opening of cell block

parts.note: OB is a common abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil, with the 's kept

indicators.note: about says the story goes around the next letter

parts.note: a tale is a story

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A former pupil's tale about the start of time in a prison block.
explanation.walkthrough: 'block' looks like part of 'cell block', but it is the definition, a noun meaning hindrance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that blocks you is a hindrance or barrier standing in your way.

clue.text: Modify top of dress during a fitting

indicators.note: during says one piece goes into the middle of the others

parts.note: just means fitting or proper, as in a just reward

indicators.note: the top of a down word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A tailor alters the neckline of a dress while the customer is being fitted.
explanation.walkthrough: D, the top of 'dress', goes inside A JUST.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: to alter something slightly is to change or adapt it.

clue.text: Fielder putting cap on head

parts.note: a cover is a lid or cap
a point is the head or tip of something, as of a spear

explanation.surface: Someone puts a hat on their head.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a cricket fielding position on the off side, between the positions called point and extra cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket names each fielder by the position they stand in, so this position stands for the player.

clue.text: Sharp expert playing crib

parts.note: an ace is an expert

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are in action and moved about

explanation.surface: A sharp-witted card expert at a game of cribbage.
explanation.walkthrough: Crib is short for cribbage, a card game, which makes 'playing crib' read naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a cutting, acid tone or remark is sharp in the bitter sense.

clue.text: Flower expert miles off

indicators.note: off says the letter is taken away

parts.note: a master is an expert

explanation.surface: A horticultural expert is miles away from a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: the Michaelmas daisy is one of this daisy-like garden plant family.

clue.text: Police officer collecting King, US novelist heard in college

indicators.note: collecting says the officer takes the king inside

parts.note: a cop is a police officer
R, for Rex, is the abbreviation for king

indicators.note: heard says the novelist's name is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: Agatha Christie was the crime novelist

explanation.surface: A detective picks up a king and an American crime writer inside a college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collecting' puts R in COP to make CORP; 'heard' turns CHRISTIE into the same-sounding CHRISTI.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: both Oxford and Cambridge have a college of this name, Latin for 'body of Christ'.

clue.text: Daughter, with bad back, in decline

indicators.note: back says the word for bad is read in the other direction

parts.note: poor means bad, as in poor work

explanation.surface: A daughter with a bad back is in poor health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad back' reads as an ailment; 'back' turns POOR to ROOP.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: to sag or flag is to sink lower or decline.

clue.text: Road hazard — this is removed in Dorset resort

indicators.note: in says the shortened word goes inside the name of the Dorset town

parts.note: Poole is a seaside town in Dorset, a county in southern England

indicators.note: removed says the following word is taken out of the one before

explanation.surface: A road hazard of this sort has been fixed in a Dorset seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this is removed' reads as the hazard being cleared away, but it is an instruction to delete two letters from a word.
explanation.definitionFit: A hole worn in a road surface is a danger to drivers and cyclists.

clue.text: Sound level for listeners

indicators.note: for listeners says the word is taken as it is heard

parts.note: straight means level, as in hanging a picture straight

explanation.surface: A sound level set for an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' is a noun here: a narrow stretch of sea, not a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym in geography: a narrow sea channel between two landmasses, like the Sound of Mull.

clue.text: Course holding permit for gambling game

indicators.note: holding says the course has the permit inside it

parts.note: a route is a course taken
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: A racecourse that holds a licence for gambling.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a casino game where a ball lands on a spinning numbered wheel.

clue.text: Wimbledon feature — inform tribunal

parts.note: to grass is British slang for informing on someone to the police
a court is a tribunal

explanation.surface: Something at Wimbledon leads to an informer before a tribunal.
explanation.walkthrough: Wimbledon is the London tennis championship, the only Grand Slam played on grass.
explanation.definitionFit: The tennis championship there is played on lawn surfaces, so these are its defining feature.

clue.text: Lit with it

definitions.meaning: illuminated, as a lamp is when its power is on
fashionable and alert, up to date

explanation.definitionFit: A lamp is illuminated when flicked on, and an alert, trendy person is described the same way.

clue.text: Stay for start of party

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Staying on for the beginning of a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stay' is a noun meaning a support, not a verb meaning remain.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a support or brace holding something up, as a stay steadies a mast.

clue.text: One wielding power behind the scenes, unpredictable in emergencies

definitions.text: One wielding power behind the scenes

indicators.note: unpredictable suggests the letters fall in no set order

explanation.surface: A shadowy power broker behaves erratically in a crisis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but its letters are part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: French for 'grey eminence', after Cardinal Richelieu's adviser: a powerful unofficial adviser who stays out of sight.

clue.text: Drain pipe fitted to vehicle

definitions.meaning: to use up completely or tire out
the tailpipe carrying fumes from a car engine

explanation.surface: A drainpipe has been fitted to a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drain pipe' reads as one plumbing item; it splits into two separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: To drain is to empty or wear out completely, and a car's fume pipe has the same name.

clue.text: Network press pitch for Americans

parts.note: a grid is a network of lines
to iron clothes is to press them

explanation.surface: A media network lobbies about a sports field for American viewers.
explanation.definitionFit: The playing field of American football is called this because of its marked lines.

clue.text: Primarily, come here in Cannes, the height of fashion

indicators.note: primarily means taking the first letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: An invitation to visit Cannes, where style reaches its peak.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: stylish elegance is the very peak of what is fashionable.

clue.text: Advocates having protective rails across street

indicators.note: across says the rails stretch over the street, enclosing it

parts.note: barriers are rails that protect

explanation.surface: Lawyers whose premises have railings set across the road.
explanation.definitionFit: In England, these lawyers argue cases in court as advocates for their clients.

clue.text: Extremely cold, some climb it in Garmisch

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Alpine climbing near Garmisch in bitterly cold weather.
explanation.walkthrough: Garmisch-Partenkirchen is a German Alpine ski resort.
explanation.definitionFit: A biting wind or frost is so cold it feels as if it nips the skin.

clue.text: Fury involving new kitchen stove

indicators.note: involving says the fury wraps around the letter

parts.note: rage is fury

explanation.surface: Anger over a new cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: A large cooking stove with burners and ovens, like an Aga, is known by this name.

clue.text: Italian football club, very European, in unjust broadcast

indicators.note: in says the two letters go inside the rearranged word
broadcast means scattered, so the letters are spread around

explanation.surface: An Italian football club, very European, complains of unfair commentary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' makes JUNTUS from 'unjust'; 'in' puts VE inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: the Turin club is one of Italy's most successful football teams.

clue.text: Popular pointer receiving attention

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
a hand is a pointer on a clock

explanation.surface: A well-liked pointer dog is being looked after.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: a matter being dealt with is said to be under control and being handled.

clue.text: Pick up article brought in by that woman

indicators.note: brought in by says the article goes inside the next word

parts.note: her refers to that woman
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: She collects an article she has brought in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pick up' looks like collecting, but means catching a sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: to pick up a signal or whisper is to catch it with the ears.

clue.text: Old character in two minds about hospital

indicators.note: about says the undecided word goes around the letter

parts.note: torn means undecided, in two minds

explanation.surface: An old eccentric dithers about going into hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old character' sounds like an eccentric person; it is an Old English letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a runic letter used in Old English for the 'th' sound, written þ.

clue.text: In consequence, departed after island cut off

indicators.note: after says the following pieces come behind the island

parts.note: so means therefore, in consequence
late means departed, as in the late king

explanation.surface: Consequently, someone left the island and was cut off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'departed' means dead here, not having left.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: to separate something from others so it stands alone and apart.
